news.title: Showdown in Samoa — the four sides aiming for the FIFA U-20 Men’s World Cup
news.lede: Four Oceania teams will go head-to-head on Friday to claim the two available spots at next year’s FIFA U-20 Men’s World Cup in Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan. The winners of Friday’s OFC U-19 Men’s Championship semi-finals at the Samoa Football HQ in Apia get the chance to represent the region at the 24-nation global tournament. The Solomon Islands will take on Tahiti in the first semi-final before New Zealand face New Caledonia in the second match. Main photo: The captains gather ahead of Friday’s semi-finals.

news.title: North Korea eyes 2nd straight title at FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup
news.lede: North Korean players celebrate their 2-0 win against Portugal in their opening match of the 2026 FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup in Lodz, Poland, Monday. Captured from FIFA's Instagram account North Korea’s women’s football team continued to showcase its dominance at the youth level, cruising to a 2-0 victory over Portugal in its opening match of the 2026 FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup. North Korea defeated Portugal, representing the Union of European Football Associations, 2-0 in Group E action in Lodz, Poland, on Monday. North Korea is drawn in Group E alongside Portugal, Costa Rica of the Confederation of North, Central America and Caribbean Association Football, and Colombia of the South American Football Confederation.

news.title: Australia head coach Popovic says he turned down 4-year contract extension

(AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson) Under Popovic’s leadership, the Socceroos reached the knockout rounds of the FIFA World Cup 2026, suffering a round-of-32 loss on penalties against Egypt. SYDNEY Australia head coach Tony Popovic said on Wednesday that he turned down a four-year contract extension and signed a deal only until next year’s Asian Cup. Under his leadership, the Socceroos reached the knockout rounds of the FIFA World Cup 2026, suffering a round-of-32 loss on penalties against Egypt.

news.title: After 20 years, India back in AFC U20 Asian Cup with FIFA U20 World Cup in sight
news.lede: Guwahati, Sept 9: India’s return to the AFC U-20 Asian Cup after a 20-year absence offers the country’s emerging footballers a chance to compete against Asia’s leading youth teams and potentially move closer to the FIFA U20 World Cup. India secured qualification for the AFC U20 Asian Cup China 2027 with a 3-0 win over Bangladesh in Tashkent on September 6. The victory took India to six points in Group B and secured their place as one of the seven best runners-up from the eight qualifying groups. India last featured in the continental U20 championship in 2006.

news.title: Korean football needs good news at the Asian Games
news.lede: Korean men's national football team players gather in circle before practice at Korea Football Park in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, Sept. Yonhap Korean football needs some good news after this year's terrible World Cup. The Asian Games start next week in Japan and it remains to be seen if this is going to be a repeat of what happened in Mexico or something much better. For the men's team, this is not that far behind the World Cup in terms of importance.

news.title: Ballon d’Or Goalkeeper of the Year: All nominees
news.lede: And this year, it brings a new set of nominees with results influenced by not just club football, but also the FIFA World Cup 2026. The World Cup had a massive impact on who ended up being nominated and nowhere is this more apparent than with the Yashin Trophy. The Yashin Trophy, named after the goalkeeping legend Lev Yashin, will be awarded to one goalkeeper each in the men’s and women’s categories. This year, ten nominees for men’s and five nominees for women’s have been selected.
